courtGates._origin: Court retrial conditions 2026-09-14 — freshness gate from round 1 as amended by retrial N2, churn gate from BUILD-SPEC v1 [REV6-4]/[REV10-4]
courtGates._kind: data-quality exclusions, fixed before a single scoreboard entry exists — NOT outcome parameters (BUILD-SPEC v1 [REV8-5])
courtGates.freshnessConsequence: freshShare < 0.95 -> lowFreshness: true, the row stays in the series but feeds no quantile window and no H-INT; guard annotation is YELLOW, never a red run; backfilled rows carry freshShare null and are exempt from the gate
courtGates.churnFormula: (nEntered + nLeft) / nUniverse against the previous publication day
courtGates.churnConsequence: highChurn: true -> excluded from quantile windows like lowFreshness, and the session writes no scoreboard entries
